mechanism: Alcohol increases hepatic metabolism of atorvastatin via CYP3A4 induction while also potentiating hepatotoxicity risk and reducing statin efficacy; excessive alcohol consumption elevates triglycerides and counteracts cardiovascular benefits.
action: Counsel patients to limit alcohol consumption to moderate levels (≤1 drink/day for women, ≤2 drinks/day for men) and monitor liver function tests periodically.
